Welcome to our Online Prospectus
Join us as a postgraduate
Whether you’re new to Royal Holloway or have studied with us previously, our online postgraduate prospectus will help prepare you for a higher degree.
Our staff and students are here to show you what makes life at Royal Holloway so special and how studying with us can help you meet your goals.
You can also download or order our printed prospectus.

Postgraduate Events
In person or online, this is your chance to meet with some of our world-leading academics, staff from key services, and current students.
Learn more
Studying here
Royal Holloway consistently ranks among the UK’s leading universities for both teaching and research, with 88% of Royal Holloway’s research rated as world-leading or internationally excellent in the latest REF (2021), putting us in the top 25% of UK universities overall. Many of our departments were ranked in the top 5 in the UK for the quality of their research outputs.
As a postgraduate student you’ll learn and work alongside experts whose research is changing the world. Our state-of-the-art facilities and supportive and inclusive community mean you’ll thrive in your chosen subject and future career.
How to apply
How to apply
Use our coursefinder tool to find a degree that suits you. Take time to speak to our Postgraduate Student Recruitment Manager, International Student Recruitment Team, your agent, or a member of academic staff if you need more information on the course.
Click Apply Now on the course you have selected, provide the requested documents in support of your application, and our Admissions Team will review your application.
We recommend submitting your application before the deadlines listed on the page below. There is no fee for applying.
How to apply
Continue your education
Continue your education
Alumni who enrol on a 2026 entry postgraduate course at Royal Holloway are automatically given a 20% discount on tuition fees for the first year. You don’t even need to apply for it!
To be eligible you will need to have Home or International fee status, and have successfully completed an undergraduate degree at Royal Holloway.
Alumni discount
Central London campus
Central London campus
Our Central London campus in Bloomsbury, a vibrant district packed with sites of cultural and historic significance, offers all the benefits of studying in the heart of the capital. You’ll gain access to industry contacts and networking opportunities provided by our academic staff, and have access to a huge range of archival and library materials through our membership of the University of London.
Central London campus
Research degrees
Research degrees
With a long and proud tradition of being at the forefront of academic research, our University is a perfect place to carry out doctoral study.
For PhD applications we recommend contacting your chosen department with a brief outline of your background and area of research, and a member of academic staff will help guide and support you in your application.

Funding
Funding
Funding a postgraduate degree can seem daunting at first but there are a number of options available, including Student Finance, scholarships, tuition fee discounts and college studentships.
Make sure to visit the scholarships section of the online prospectus to learn more about what's on offer.
Fees and funding
Scholarships
Scholarships
We have a wide range of scholarships available to help support you in your studies. Visit our scholarships search page to see a full list and select the ones that are right for you.
Scholarships
International students
International students
Positioned close to both Gatwick and Heathrow airports, Royal Holloway is a global university which welcomes students from all over the world.
Our expert International Student Recruitment Team is on hand to offer events, meetings and general support so you know exactly what to expect from the application process, throughout your degree, and beyond.
Whether you choose to live close to the beautiful natural surroundings of our Egham campus or in bustling London, you’ll find Royal Holloway will become a home-away-from-home in no time.
International students

Student experience
Accommodation
Accommodation
Ryan lives in George Eliot Hall, one of the accommodation options available to you as a postgraduate student. George Eliot is our newest hall and is laid out in townhouses, but we’ve got lots of other styles to suit your requirements and budget.
Whether you'll be taught primarily on our Egham campus or our London campus, we have plenty of options for you to explore.
Accommodation
Being a student
Being a student
Exploring new interests, developing fresh skills and enjoying an active social life are an important part of being a student - at Royal Holloway you’ll have plenty of opportunity to do all three.
Being a student
Egham campus tour
Egham campus tour
Why wouldn’t you want to study on one of the most beautiful university campuses in the world? Our Egham campus is home to teaching and study spaces, bars and cafés, high-quality accommodation, and dynamic sports facilities. All of this is set in 135 acres of stunning green space. It’s a friendly place, where a close-knit community thrives.
Our Egham campus
London campus tour
London campus tour
Our London campus is made up of three buildings, just a few minutes apart: 11 Bedford Square, Senate House and Stewart House.
You’ll be taught in modern seminar rooms with access to the University of London’s Senate House Library. And if you need somewhere comfortable to relax between teaching sessions, we have breakout areas and common rooms.
Central London campus
Places to eat on campus
Places to eat on our Egham campus
Need somewhere sleek to grab a coffee and get some work done? Or somewhere comfy to enjoy a home-cooked meal with friends? Our large range of eateries on campus all have their own style and character, designed to suit every budget, taste, mood and dietary need.
Dining on campus
The local area
The local area
Our Egham campus is located in Surrey, in the South-East of England. The centre of London is just 40 minutes away by train, and we’re seven miles from London Heathrow airport. Shop, eat, relax and take in entertainment and culture in nearby Windsor and Staines, or connect with nature and recharge in parkland within walking distance of campus.
We’re perfectly placed to give you access to whatever kind of scene you want.
The local area
Commuting
Commuting
Muhammad shares his experience as a student living at home and commuting to Royal Holloway.
If you want to travel to campus instead of living here, don’t worry - our free parking and easy public transport links make commuting an easy alternative, and there’s lots of support for you to plan ahead, get involved and make friends.
Commuting students
Wellbeing
Wellbeing
Delphine explains more about supporting you at Royal Holloway.
Starting university is a big step but if things get tough, we’re here for you. Whether it’s money issues, mental health problems, exam stress, worries about unwelcome attention or something that doesn't feel right, or anything else, our Wellbeing team is there to offer support and signpost you to the right place for help.
Support and wellbeing
Faith
Faith
Open to students of all beliefs and none, our multi-faith community aims to support you in your personal faith and spiritual journey, whatever your background or circumstances.
Your faith
Sport
Sport
Ellie talks about how being on the netball and lacrosse teams had a positive impact on her time at Royal Holloway, and how our active sessions were able to help her get back into sport.
There’s a whole host of opportunities and fantastic facilities to be active at Royal Holloway; whether that’s playing sport competitively against other universities, exercising to keep fit or having a go at something new such as Ultimate Frisbee, Ninjutsu or whatever takes your fancy.
Sport
Study spaces tour
Study spaces
Join Muhammad as he shares his favourite spots for studying on our Egham campus - whether you prefer silent study or social spaces for groupwork, there's something for everyone.
Follow him around campus as he visits Founder's Building, Emily Wilding Davison Building and the Boilerhouse. Conveniently, all of these spots are close to our cafés and restaurants so you can grab a bite to eat too. Take your own tour with our Virtual Experience.
Virtual experience
Employability
We'll prepare you for the modern workforce as a priority from day one. Our focus on employability will support you to identify and articulate the skills and achievements you gain through your course and other activities as you prepare for graduate employment.
From the day you arrive, and for two years after you graduate, you’ll be able to access our Careers Service, where you can find practical support like CV and job application checks and book one-to-one appointments to help you plan out and fulfil your career goals. We run regular careers and part-time jobs fairs to find new opportunities and arrange talks by speakers from a range of industries, where you can find out exactly what employers are looking for.
